backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining Song and PersonalSong types with CRUD operations, user profiles, access control integration via MixinAuthorization, and blob storage for audio/cover files with role-based upload permissions (admin for public catalog, user for personal library).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented voice search features in HeaderSearchBar: microphone icon integration, pink/magenta theme styling with hover states, listening overlay/pulsing animation, and connection to useVoiceSearch hook for automatic search execution.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend files including global styles with cherry blossom theme and micPulseGlow animation, React Query hooks with fixed error handling, audio queue management with Now Playing UI state, responsive layout with sidebar/header, and admin dashboard with grant access functionality.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS with OKLCH color palette for light/dark modes, custom utilities for animated hero backgrounds, stable scrollbar gutter, header offset variables, page-search-bar class, and micPulseGlow keyframe animation for voice search microphone with pink glow effect.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Fourleaf branding, favicon reference to v3 icon asset, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with TanStack Router setup defining routes for library, my-library, pricing, player-layout, now-playing, and admin dashboard with AdminRouteGuard, wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminRoute: Route guard component that checks authentication and admin permissions, rendering login prompt for unauthenticated users, loading state during permission check, and RequestAdminAccessCard for non-admin users with navigation fallback.
frontend/src/components/admin/GrantAdmin: Admin control card component with form to grant admin access by validating and submitting Principal IDs, featuring input validation, error handling, loading states, and success/error toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/admin/RequestAdm: Displays an access denied card for non-admin users, showing their Principal ID with a copy-to-clipboard button so they can request admin access from existing administrators.
frontend/src/components/admin/SongEditor: Dialog component for creating or editing songs in the admin catalog, handling audio/cover file uploads with progress tracking, validation, and error diagnostics. Supports both create and edit modes with form state management.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button that toggles between Sign In and Sign Out states using Internet Identity, with UI sound effects and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/branding/Fourlea: Renders the Fourleaf brand logo (a green four-leaf clover on black circle) with three variants: full (logo + text), icon (logo only), and compact (smaller logo + text).
frontend/src/components/catalog/CatalogS: Displays a song row in the catalog with cover art, title, artist, album, duration, and play/pause controls. Responsive layout with different views for mobile and desktop.
frontend/src/components/catalog/Download: Download button for songs that checks authentication and subscription status, showing appropriate locked states with tooltips and handling MP3 file downloads for subscribed users.
frontend/src/components/catalog/PublicSo: Dialog for uploading new songs to the public catalog with form fields for metadata, audio file and cover image uploads, progress tracking, validation, and error handling with diagnostics.
frontend/src/components/home/HorizontalS: Container component that creates a horizontally scrollable row with snap-to-item behavior, hidden scrollbar, and smooth scrolling for displaying content cards.
frontend/src/components/home/StreamingCa: A card component displaying a song with cover art, title, artist, and a play/pause button that appears on hover. Captures card geometry for transition animations and integrates with audio queue and UI sounds.
frontend/src/components/home/StreamingSe: A reusable section component for the home page that displays a title with optional icon and "Show all" button, wrapping child content in a consistent layout.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout component with responsive left sidebar (drawer on mobile), header with hamburger menu and login button, scrollable main content area, right details panel (desktop only), persistent audio player bar, and profile setup dialog.
frontend/src/components/layout/HeaderSea: Search bar component with home button, search input, voice search microphone button, and browse menu dropdown. Handles voice transcription, navigation, and browsing filter controls with keyboard accessibility.
frontend/src/components/layout/HomeTabBa: Tab bar component for filtering home content by 'All', 'Music', or 'Podcast' categories with active state styling.
frontend/src/components/layout/LeftSideb: Collapsible left sidebar navigation with brand logo, navigation items (Home, Library, Pricing, Player Layout), admin link, and UI sound controls. Transforms to off-canvas drawer on mobile with close button.
frontend/src/components/layout/RightDeta: Right sidebar panel (desktop only) displaying currently playing song details including cover art, title, artist, and album information.
frontend/src/components/personal/Persona: Dialog for uploading personal songs with form fields for title, artist, album, duration, audio file, and cover image. Includes validation, progress tracking, authentication checks, and diagnostics dialog for troubleshooting upload errors.
frontend/src/components/player/AudioPlay: Audio player bar component that manages playback of catalog and personal songs, handles audio streaming, playback controls (play/pause/skip/volume), seek requests, and integrates with the audio queue and now playing view.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup that collects name and subscription status, appears automatically for authenticated users without a profile, and prevents dismissal until completed.
frontend/src/components/settings/UISound: Settings component that provides toggle and volume slider controls for UI sound effects using the useUISoundSettings hook.
frontend/src/components/upload/UploadDia: Diagnostic dialog that displays user permissions, role, and principal ID for troubleshooting upload issues, with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance, handling authentication state changes and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAudioQueue.ts: Zustand store managing the audio playback queue, including queue items from catalog or personal sources, playback state, volume, timing, and now playing view state.
frontend/src/hooks/useHeaderSearch.ts: Zustand store managing the global header search query state with methods to set and clear the search text.
frontend/src/hooks/useHomeBrowsing.ts: Zustand store managing home page browsing state including active tab (All/Music/Podcast), scroll-to-browsing requests, and filter reset functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including songs, personal songs, user profiles, and song uploads with error handling and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useUISounds.ts: Hook that plays UI click sounds using HTML5 Audio API, respecting user's sound settings and handling autoplay restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/useUISoundSettings.ts: Zustand store for persisting UI sound settings (enabled/disabled and volume) to local storage.
frontend/src/hooks/useVoiceSearch.ts: Hook providing voice search functionality using Web Speech API with browser compatibility checks, error handling, and transcript management.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark theme colors (cherry blossom palette), animations for hero background and microphone pulse, and utility classes for layout.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin dashboard page for managing music catalog with track listing, upload/edit/delete functionality, admin grant controls, and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/LibraryPage.tsx: Main library page displaying all public catalog songs with filtering, search, streaming sections, and upload functionality. Handles song playback, queue management, and navigation to browsing sections.
frontend/src/pages/MyLibraryPage.tsx: Personal library page for authenticated users to view, upload, and manage their private song collection. Shows login prompt for unauthenticated users and handles song removal with toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/NowPlayingPage.tsx: Full-screen now playing page displaying album artwork, song metadata, playback controls, progress slider, and volume control. Navigates back to home if no song is playing.
frontend/src/pages/PlayerLayoutPage.tsx: Experimental player layout page with sidebar navigation, hero section, playback controls, and track list display. Demonstrates alternative UI design for music player interface.
frontend/src/pages/PricingPage.tsx: Pricing page displaying three subscription tiers (Weekly, Monthly, Yearly) with features, discounts, and call-to-action buttons. Includes FAQ section at the bottom.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrors.ts: Utility functions to normalize backend error messages into user-friendly text by detecting error types (authorization, validation, storage, etc.) and stripping raw trap messages. Includes helper to check if errors are authorization-related.
frontend/src/utils/buildSongUpdate.ts: Exports a function that builds a properly typed Update payload for song uploads, conditionally including the optional coverImage field only when provided.
frontend/src/utils/uploadValidation.ts: Provides validation functions and constants for audio file uploads (max 100MB), cover images (max 10MB), duration, and required fields with typed error results.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, Fourleaf branding theme, glow effects, animations (accordion, pulse-glow), and extended typography/container plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking for Fourleaf music streaming app with pink/magenta theme, documenting existing voice search integration features and architectural notes.
